description: Initialize Python project with modern tooling and dependency management
steps: Create pyproject.toml with project metadata, Python 3.11+ requirement
Add core dependencies: httpx, boto3, typer (CLI), pydantic (validation), structlog (logging)
Add dev dependencies: pytest, pytest-asyncio, ruff (linting), mypy (type checking)
Create src/prediction_data/ package structure with __init__.py
Create tests/ directory with conftest.py
Set up .gitignore for Python projects

description: Establish the core package layout following domain-driven organization
steps: Create src/prediction_data/cli/ module for CLI commands
Create src/prediction_data/bronze/ module for bronze layer logic
Create src/prediction_data/bronze/polymarket/ submodule (empty placeholder)
Create src/prediction_data/bronze/kalshi/ submodule (empty placeholder)
Create src/prediction_data/core/ module for shared utilities
Create src/prediction_data/storage/ module for S3 operations

description: Build the CLI entry point and command structure
steps: Create main CLI application using Typer in src/prediction_data/cli/main.py
Add 'ingest' command group as placeholder
Implement --version flag showing package version
Configure CLI entry point 'prediction-data' in pyproject.toml
Verify CLI installs and runs with 'prediction-data --help'

description: Set up configuration management via environment variables
steps: Create src/prediction_data/core/config.py with pydantic Settings class
Define BRONZE_BUCKET environment variable (required)
Define AWS_REGION environment variable (default: us-east-1)
Define LOG_LEVEL environment variable (default: INFO)
Create .env.example file documenting all environment variables

description: Configure structured logging for CloudWatch compatibility
steps: Create src/prediction_data/core/logging.py with structlog configuration
Configure JSON output format for production (CloudWatch compatible)
Configure console output format for local development
Add standard fields: timestamp, level, logger name
Create helper function to bind context (platform, entity, run_id, dt)

description: Verify the project bootstrap is complete and functional
steps: Run 'pip install -e .' successfully in a virtual environment
Verify 'prediction-data --help' shows CLI structure
Verify 'prediction-data --version' shows version
Run ruff check with no errors
Run mypy with no errors on src/
